errors.message: a property or cache key is read before any write establishes it
errors.remediation: Write the property or cache key on every path that reaches this read, or give it a default.

warnings.message: a map or script has no typed effect contract, so its state effects are unknown
warnings.remediation: Declare a typed effect contract for this map or script, or set the state explicitly with a property step. A declaration alone is not enough: its CONTENT must be backed by a server-side authority — inspection of the resolved map or child process, or a vetted script registry entry — and a declaration with no such backing is inert. An undeclared or inert effect never establishes state.
